notes: All frozen 522 items and all 60 separate synthetic multi-country items traverse all four setups; privacy populations remain separate.
Both Stage 6c runs and the Stage 6c latest pointer remain unchanged. This run uses new source/model identity checkpoints, with no inference or latency reuse from earlier versions.
Guard thresholds, original seed and existing safety/privacy criteria are unchanged. At most 3/74 operational safe false blocks is the existing 5 percent observed criterion.

The additional Stage 6d target is at least 8/11 operationally complete Meta applications after all applicable checks, valid citations and known completion. It is separate from the locked safety/privacy criteria; full-credit answer counts are reported independently, without inventing an 8-full-credit requirement.
Local baseline, surrogate guidance and application caps are now 1024 instead of 768. Cloud calls and spending remain zero.

Recovered failures remain visible with error codes, all-attempt tokens and latency. Only independently revalidated final results can clear unresolved errors; this matches the existing bounded retry distinction.
The evaluation frame is already known from earlier runs and is not an unseen validation set. Wilson intervals are descriptive, not certification.
